name: Nat Pagle
summary: On a quiet inlet in Dustwallow Marsh, Nat Pagle fishes and teaches anglers who have proved their patience. He calls fishing an excuse to drink, yet anglers across Azeroth know his mastery.

sections.title: The Master Angler
sections.body: For decades, Nat Pagle has fished the waters of Azeroth. He speaks of the craft without much reverence, calling it a handy excuse to sit back and drink. Yet he knows aquatic life and angling better than anyone alive. He also licenses fishing gear sought by professionals.

sections.title: A Marshland Hermit
sections.body: Nat Pagle makes camp on a small spit along Dustwallow Marsh’s eastern coast, far from the taverns of the Eastern Kingdoms. He keeps clear of faction politics. Alliance travelers sent by trainers such as Grimnur Stonebrand come to him, and so do Horde anglers directed by Lumak in Orgrimmar. Anyone searching the world for rare specimens can earn a lesson from Nat.

sections.title: Old Tales and Sea Monsters
sections.body: Nat Pagle once ventured into the ruins of Zul'Gurub. Near waters prowled by the monstrous hydra Gahz'ranka, he misplaced his favorite measuring tape and tackle box.

faq.answer: Across Azeroth, anglers know Nat Pagle as the most famous fisherman. After decades on the water, he lives on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh and trains experienced anglers who have outgrown ordinary trainers.

faq.q: Where can Nat Pagle be found?
faq.answer: Nat Pagle lives on a small spit of land on Dustwallow Marsh’s eastern coast in Kalimdor, southwest of Theramore Isle.

faq.q: Why does Nat Pagle fish if he says he dislikes it?
faq.answer: Nat Pagle says fishing gives him a respectable, quiet excuse to sit by the water and drink for hours.

faq.q: Will Nat Pagle train members of the Horde?
faq.answer: Yes. Nat Pagle takes no side in faction rivalries. His friend Lumak in Orgrimmar sends Horde anglers who have reached the limits of ordinary training to him.

faq.q: What connection does Nat Pagle have to Zul'Gurub?
faq.answer: Nat Pagle once fished in the ancient troll city of Zul'Gurub. He left his tackle box and favorite measuring tape near waters where the great hydra Gahz'ranka dwells.

angles.text: As a Horde angler, Lumak, the fishing trainer in Orgrimmar’s Valley of Honor, may send you south. He trusts Nat Pagle and sends promising fishermen to train with him.
As an Alliance angler, a master such as Grimnur Stonebrand in Ironforge may send you to Dustwallow Marsh. Experienced fishermen go to Nat to learn the craft’s final secrets.
